title: Ha Yanagi — Lament of the Willow
revision: Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance (roster pass) / Ha Yanagi classification / forked tree

classification.selector: jutsu classification: the qualifying element(s), whatever the jutsu's source
classification.applies_to: matching supported tags on all Ha Yanagi-classified jutsu
not_selectors: equipment / required bloodline item (castability gate only)
classification.off_kit_coverage: unverified (no non-bloodline jutsu catalog with effect rows in the repository)

emphasis.primary: Enemy debuff control: Decrease Damage Given (Wailing Bark, Petal Nightmare) and Increase Damage Taken (Blighted Tree)
emphasis.secondary: Self amplification: the Wailing Bark Increase Damage Given row, which multiplies every non-pierce hit the caster lands in its window
emphasis.tertiary: None: Damage is left unamplified. Its one meaningful row is Blighted Tree's formula 40 EP hit; Petal Nightmare's Damage row is static, 40 raw HP outside the EP ladder
emphasis.rationale: Three of the kit's six supported rows are enemy debuffs. Mourning Boughs answers "How do I wither the enemy: blunt their blows or open them to every strike?": Grave Willow's Hush takes both compounding Decrease Damage Given rows to +10% (Wailing Bark 45%, Petal Nightmare 40%), and Hollow at the Heart takes the single Blighted Tree exposure row to +8% (30 → 38%, ×1.062); that capstone carries no suppression rider, but its route keeps Mourning Boughs' +2% Decrease Damage Given (+5% with Veil of Falling Petals). Whispering Canopy answers "How do I make my own blows land harder?" with one chain: Thousand-Leaf Dream takes the one Wailing Bark self buff to 45%. No node targets Damage: Blighted Tree's formula 40 EP hit is its one meaningful row, and Petal Nightmare's static row deals 40 raw HP. Every percentage row lists all four stat types and no element, so each reaches every non-pierce hit, not Genjutsu only. Potency reaches matching supported tags on all Ha Yanagi-classified jutsu (RUL-2026-10-03-005; requires a classification extension).

nodes.name: Mourning Boughs
nodes.flavor: The willow bows under its grief, and every arm raised against it grows heavy.
nodes.coverage_note: Decrease Damage Given on Wailing Bark 35 → 37% and Petal Nightmare 30 → 32% (enemy, 2 rounds); the two debuffs compound on one target. In every full build, and the Amplifier route's fixed fourth purchase.

nodes.name: Veil of Falling Petals
nodes.flavor: Petals drift between the foe and its purpose until the blow forgets its aim.
nodes.coverage_note: Both suppression rows 37 → 40% and 32 → 35% with Mourning Boughs.

nodes.name: Grave Willow's Hush
nodes.flavor: Beneath the oldest willow nothing strikes true; the grave keeps its quiet.
nodes.coverage_note: Suppression: Wailing Bark 35 → 45% and Petal Nightmare 30 → 40% on the full route; a target under both deals ×0.55 × 0.60 = ×0.33 on a non-pierce hit (×0.455 at base), ×0.725 against the unmodified kit, Red Pestilence's factor.

nodes.name: Blight Takes Root
nodes.flavor: Rot finds the soft heart of a tree, and of a foe, and settles in to stay.
nodes.coverage_note: Exposure commit for Hollow at the Heart: Blighted Tree 30 → 33% (enemy, the 2 rounds after the cast, never its own hit).

nodes.name: Hollow at the Heart
nodes.flavor: What the blight has hollowed, any passing wind can break.
nodes.coverage_note: Exposure: Blighted Tree 30 → 38% on the full route, ×1.38 / 1.30 ≈ ×1.062 against the unmodified row (Shakunetsu Sakura ×1.075), on every non-pierce hit the target takes for 2 rounds, allies' hits included.

nodes.name: Whispering Canopy
nodes.flavor: The leaves speak in a thousand voices, and all of them say strike.
nodes.coverage_note: Wailing Bark self Increase Damage Given 35 → 38% (the 2 rounds after each 40 AP cast, cooldown 6); every non-pierce hit you land in that window.

nodes.name: Rising Sap
nodes.flavor: Spring climbs the trunk, and the willow remembers how to be fierce.
nodes.coverage_note: Wailing Bark self buff 38 → 40% with Whispering Canopy.

nodes.name: Thousand-Leaf Dream
nodes.flavor: Every leaf a dream, every dream a wound; the canopy closes overhead.
nodes.coverage_note: Sustained amplification: Wailing Bark self buff 35 → 45% on the full route, ×1.45 on every non-pierce hit you land in the 2 rounds after the cast.

examples.name: Grave Willow's Hush
examples.rationale: Both Decrease Damage Given rows at +10% (Wailing Bark 45%, Petal Nightmare 40%; ×0.55 × 0.60 = ×0.33 on a non-pierce hit when both sit on one target, ×0.455 at base). Whispering Canopy is the fourth purchase, so the same 40 AP Wailing Bark cast also grants a 38% self buff; Blight Takes Root (exposure 33%) is the alternative.

examples.name: Hollow at the Heart
examples.rationale: Blighted Tree exposure 30 → 38% (×1.062 against the unmodified row): ×1.38 on every non-pierce hit the target takes in the 2 rounds after the cast, from you, allies or weapons, never Blighted Tree's own hit. Veil of Falling Petals is the fourth purchase: the route's +2% Decrease Damage Given from Mourning Boughs becomes +5% (suppression 35 → 40% and 30 → 35%), half the Suppression route's +10%. Whispering Canopy (self buff 38%, ×1.38 × 1.38 ≈ ×1.90 on a hit inside both windows) is the offensive alternative.

examples.name: Thousand-Leaf Dream
examples.rationale: Wailing Bark becomes a 45% self buff for 40 AP on cooldown 6: every non-pierce hit you land in the 2 rounds after the cast, normal jutsu, weapons and basic attacks included, is multiplied by ×1.45 (the bloodline passive applies after it). Mourning Boughs is the only fourth purchase, so the same cast also suppresses the target to 37% (Petal Nightmare 32%). A Blighted Tree cast in the window lands ×1.45, and while its untreed 30% mark is also up your later hits land ×1.45 × 1.30 ≈ ×1.89.

narrow_kit_exception: Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four. The kit has four supported tags on six rows; Decrease Damage Given (suppression), Increase Damage Taken (exposure) and Increase Damage Given (amplification) each own a route, and the fourth, Damage, reaches one meaningful row: Blighted Tree's formula 40 EP hit (60 AP, cooldown 7). Petal Nightmare's Damage row is static and deals its raw power, 40 HP before modifiers, so +N Damage there is +N HP. A flat-Damage capstone at the batch's +2 maximum (Blighted Tree 40 → 42 EP) is ×1.05 on one hit every 7 rounds, less than Thousand-Leaf Dream's +10% gives that hit inside its window (×1.45 / 1.35 ≈ ×1.074) while the amplifier also lifts every other hit there, so the route would be outweighed; its percentage setup would either twin Rising Sap (an Increase Damage Given setup stacks with it through Thousand-Leaf Dream's fourth purchase) or repeat Veil of Falling Petals' or Blight Takes Root's tag on the same rows as a third commit. The pre-batch flat-Damage route (Hardened Heartwood → Nightmare in Bloom) is therefore not kept, and the Hardened Heartwood leaf is removed rather than kept only to avoid a universal node. Mourning Boughs is universal: it is in every legal 4-BP build, so the Amplifier build is fixed (06, 09, 10 + 01) and every build carries +2% Decrease Damage Given.
design_notes: Structure: Mourning Boughs (enemy, universal) forks into Veil of Falling Petals → Grave Willow's Hush (suppression) and Blight Takes Root → Hollow at the Heart (exposure); Whispering Canopy (self) runs one chain, Rising Sap → Thousand-Leaf Dream (sustained amplification). Maxima over every legal allocation: Decrease Damage Given +10%, Increase Damage Given +10%, Increase Damage Taken +8%; no node targets Damage.

2026-10-04 rebalance: the pre-batch flat-Damage route (Hardened Heartwood → Nightmare in Bloom, +5 Damage: Blighted Tree formula 40 → 45 EP, Normal → High; Petal Nightmare static 40 → 45 raw HP) was cut, then removed; the roster pass also removes its Hardened Heartwood leaf (narrow-kit exception). Also in this batch: the +2% Decrease Damage Given rider on Hollow at the Heart is removed and Hollow at the Heart +7% → +5% (exposure +10% → +8%); Rising Sap +3% → +2% and Thousand-Leaf Dream +4% → +5%, so Amplifier stays +10% with the payoff on the capstone.

Fourth purchases: Suppression adds Whispering Canopy (+3% IDG) or Blight Takes Root (+3% IDT); Exposure adds Veil of Falling Petals (+5% DDG in all) or Whispering Canopy; Amplifier's fourth is always Mourning Boughs (+2% DDG). No fourth adds to its own route's primary tag, and none reaches more than half of a sibling route's primary.

Arithmetic: every percentage row lists all four stat types and no element, so each matches damage of any element (§3). Jutsu-sourced increases multiply the hit in turn and reductions apply in sequence (computeDamagePacket, §3b). Exposure with Whispering Canopy gives ×1.38 × 1.38 ≈ ×1.90 on a hit inside both windows, Amplifier ×1.45 × 1.30 ≈ ×1.89 with Blighted Tree's untreed mark up; Amplifier leads in the Wailing Bark window alone (×1.45 against ×1.38), Exposure in the Blighted Tree window alone (×1.38 against ×1.30) and on allies' hits. The +15% bloodline Increase Damage Given passive applies last; pierce runs after the modifier pass.

Delivery: all three casts are OTHER_USER SINGLE. Wailing Bark 40 AP, cooldown 6 (suppression row plus the self buff); Blighted Tree 60 AP, cooldown 7 (formula Damage plus exposure); Petal Nightmare 60 AP, cooldown 6 (static Damage, 40 raw HP, plus suppression). Every percentage row is live the two rounds after its cast, never in it, so no cast boosts its own hit. Both suppression debuffs on one target in one round cost 100 AP. Not simulated.
risks: Classification: no kit row carries an element, so the tree requires a classification extension. 'Ha Yanagi' is the placeholder name of a new jutsu classification assigned to jutsu records, not a bloodline-id selector; which jutsu carry it is a director/engine decision. All three kit jutsu qualify only through it (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1). Off-kit coverage is unverified.

Suppression stacking: Wailing Bark and Petal Nightmare each apply a separate two-round Decrease Damage Given debuff; with BATTLE_TAG_STACKING every active same-tag effect applies (process.ts 1109–1117, §3b) and the reductions compound, so one target's non-pierce hits fall to ×0.65 × 0.70 = ×0.455 at base and ×0.55 × 0.60 = ×0.33 at the +10% route maximum (floor ×0.10). The strongest defensive package in the tree. Not simulated.

Downstream reach: the Wailing Bark self buff raises normal jutsu, weapons and basic attacks in its window; suppression cuts non-pierce damage from every source the target controls; exposure raises non-pierce hits from allies and weapons, so Hollow at the Heart is worth more in group fights than its single row suggests.

Single-row routes: Exposure (Blighted Tree, cooldown 7) and Amplifier (Wailing Bark, cooldown 6) each ride one row, live 2 rounds per cast. Exposure stops at +8%: at +10% it would equal Amplifier's gain on the caster's own hits (×1.40 / 1.30 ≈ ×1.077 against ×1.45 / 1.35 ≈ ×1.074 per window) while adding allies' hits and the larger suppression fourth, leaving Amplifier only its cheaper, shorter-cooldown cast. Hollow at the Heart carries no suppression rider, but the route keeps Mourning Boughs' +2% Decrease Damage Given (+5% with Veil of Falling Petals). Amplifier keeps +10% on the one self row.

Targeting: all three casts are OTHER_USER and may be aimed at any living non-caster user, allies included (util.ts 2747–2749; actions.ts 1029–1068). Every damage and debuff row has friendly fire none/ALL, so aimed at an ally it damages, suppresses (up to 45%) or exposes (up to 38%) that ally; SINGLE method, so this is player-controlled.

Pierce and passives: no node touches pierce, and pierce runs after the modifier pass, so suppression and exposure do not change pierce hits. The bloodline's permanent +5% Increase Damage Taken passive (Taijutsu/Bukijutsu, no element) is not a jutsu row; no node raises or removes it.

Rank and scope: Ha Yanagi is a D-rank bloodline. No node changes either Damage row: Blighted Tree's formula 40 EP hit and Petal Nightmare's static 40 raw HP stay at base. Skill-tree effects are skipped in ranked modes; no combat simulation was performed.

audit.revision: Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance (roster pass) / Ha Yanagi classification / forked tree
limits: Proposed element-wide potency classification; not implemented or verified in the live engine (needs a jutsu-classification resolver).

Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Ha Yanagi-classified jutsu (requires classification extension). Off-kit jutsu of the element are in scope by rule; their count is unverified. Original combat elements, recipients and stat/general/element filters stay intact.
Bloodline id, equipment, injected-child provenance and jutsu names are not selectors; equipment only gates castability.
Coverage counts below are this kit's rows only. Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.
Damage values are raw power (EP), not final-damage percentages; every other modifier is shown with %. Percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.

Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.
Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.
No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.
Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit.

design_review.director_review: Roster questions: DQ-B (Hollow at the Heart +8% exposure on one row, Blighted Tree 30 → 38%, ×1.062; under a +10% single-row rule the capstone becomes +7%, route ×1.077); DQ-C (Grave Willow's Hush +10% Decrease Damage Given on two rows, Wailing Bark 35 → 45% and Petal Nightmare 30 → 40%, ×0.725 with both live, equal to Red Pestilence on the same bases); DQ-H (10 → 8 nodes: the pre-batch flat-Damage route, Hardened Heartwood → Nightmare in Bloom, is removed, leaving three Advanced Arts, Mourning Boughs universal and Damage unamplified; narrow-kit exception).
concerns: Mourning Boughs is universal (acknowledged in the narrow-kit exception): the Amplifier build is fixed (06, 09, 10 + 01) and every build carries +2% Decrease Damage Given. Every leaf that would avoid this is filler: a Damage leaf reaches one meaningful row (Blighted Tree 40 → 42 EP, ×1.05 on one hit every 7 rounds), and a percentage leaf twins a Hidden Art on the same rows.

A Damage-focused player has no route and Damage is unamplified. A flat-Damage capstone at +2 (Blighted Tree 40 → 42 EP, ×1.05) would give that one hit less than Thousand-Leaf Dream already gives it in the window (×1.074) and only +2 raw HP on Petal Nightmare's static row.

Exposure stops at +8% (×1.062, below Shakunetsu Sakura's ×1.075) against Amplifier's +10% (×1.074), both single rows, for the sibling reason in the risks (DQ-B). Hollow at the Heart +7% (exposure +10%, ×1.077) is the change here if the roster rule for single-row exposure is +10%.

Suppression +10% on two compounding rows (×0.725 against the unmodified kit; ×0.33 on a target under both) is above the roster's +8% two-row convention (DQ-C); the written kit reason is the director-approved Blood-Enchanted Eyes Red Pestilence route, +10% Decrease Damage Given on the same 35% / 30% bases (RUL-2026-10-04-001). Grave Willow's Hush is single-tag where Red Pestilence carries a Decrease Damage Taken rider; the kit has no defensive self row, so this capstone reads lighter than the anchor.

Thousand-Leaf Dream is a bare single-row +10% Increase Damage Given capstone, where the anchors give +10% amplification a rider or stop at +8% (Arashima). Its fixed fourth makes the full build +10% Increase Damage Given, +2% Decrease Damage Given, close to Shakunetsu Sakura's Scorching Hanami package (+10% / +3%); the kit has no other rider tag that is not a sibling's primary.
The generated Damage-tier line labels Petal Nightmare's static row "40 (Normal)"; that row is 40 raw HP outside the player-jutsu EP ladder, so the label is a renderer limitation. No node changes it.
